semantics: Exact least number of gates of a circuit that is right on the n*m inputs with exactly one row wire and one column wire on (Lean: PEqualNP.Represents.Represents). "mono": AND/OR gates of fan-in at most two (Monotone2, RepSizeAtMost). "not": AND/OR/NOT gates, NOT counted (FanInTwo). Constants cost a gate, a missing wire reads false, the output may be an input wire or a missing wire. Inputs: the 8 stars (wires 0..7: left/row vertices, then right/column vertices) PLUS the free encoder wires rb0=0, rb0=1, rb1=0, rb1=1, cb0=0, cb0=1, cb1=0, cb1=1 (wire order as listed in "inputs": for each row-index bit i the set {u : bit_i(u) = 0} then {u : bit_i(u) = 1}, then the same for the column index). Witnesses are .ckt texts (toolkit/FORMAT.md). "exact": true means every smaller size was refuted exhaustively in the full model; otherwise "lower" is the proved lower bound and "size" the best circuit found (or null).
symmetry: index-bit permutations and complementations on each side, and transpose (group order 128)
rows_convention: bit v of rows[u] = A u v; the class representative is the member with the least value of sum_u rows[u] * 2^(m*u)
